# <PHASE>-<TASK>: <title>

- **Status:** [ ] / [~] / [x] / [!]
- **Mode:** inline | dispatch (role, model, effort)
- **Started:** YYYY-MM-DD · **Finished:** YYYY-MM-DD · **Commit:** <hash or "not committed">

## Goal

One or two sentences. What is true when this task is done?

## Done when

A verifiable criterion, for example "T-91 fails, then passes".

## Files

- path/to/file

## Steps

- [ ] 1. ...
- [ ] 2. ...

## Evidence

Paste the command, its exit code and the key output lines for each verified step.

## Decisions

Decisions made during the task, with the source (owner answer, doc reference).

## Handoff note

What the next agent must know if the work stops here.
